note: The running total of repositories over time. Flat stretches mean no new repos were created; steps up mark creation months.
methodology: Start from the same monthly creation counts as the per-month chart.
Compute the running total (cumulative sum) so each month shows the total number of repos that existed by that point.
The latest month and its total are annotated on the chart.
population: Repositories currently in the organisation, by the month GitHub records them as created. Deleted or transferred-out repositories are not counted.
